result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical or major broken elements. However, there are a few minor issues related to content truncation and potential visual inconsistencies in the promotional banner and restaurant cards.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section, which may confuse users about the full name.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a tooltip on hover/tap to show the full name or adjust the layout to accommodate longer names.

issues.description: The '-0%' discount badge on the bottom pizza card seems unusual and potentially misleading, as 0% implies no discount.
issues.suggestion: Review the logic for displaying discount badges to ensure they only appear when there is an actual discount greater than 0%.

issues.description: The promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' has a large empty space on the right side which could be utilized better.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a relevant illustration or adjusting the layout to balance the visual weight of the banner.
